description: In an infinite set, for a finite set \(F\) and a condition \(C\) independent of \(x\), \((\exists x\;(C\land x\notin F))\leftrightarrow C\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.equality_finite_exclusions.{u} {M : Type u} [Infinite M]
  (s : Finset M) (C : Prop) : (∃ x, C ∧ x ∉ s) ↔ C
